objective: Separate preparation gaps, source observation limitations, engineering invalidity and unresolved mechanisms before any new method/edit-result evaluation.

source_contract.attachment_role: XLSX taxonomy and historical evidence-status only; instructions/actions in cells are not executed and are not actor features
allowlist: original raw TFRecord sensor records and source annotations
legally supplied original body mask with explicit role
immutable original all-branch G and original none layers when separately measured
source-only frozen actor registry/observations and source resource inventory
prohibited: student predictions, policy scores or methods success
privileged complete simulation geometry or edited semantic/depth used as deployment features
historical XLSX success/failure percentages used as actor thresholds
post-score adjustment of cohort or thresholds
source_contract.deployment_role: Waymo annotations are explicitly annotation-assisted; simulator masks stay simulator_sensor_oracle; neither is an automatic real-deployment guarantee

frame_domains: source samples within declared native49 inventory, not verified training split
denominators.missing_values: null with reason and original denominator; zero support only where the measurement domain and validity are defined
denominators.statistical_unit: physical scene/object ancestor, not frames or 4912 correlated operation records

actual_range_image_layer.meaning: actual decoded range-image rows inside same-frame source annotation box; not a semantic/body-surface completeness measure

measured_now.source_integrity_scope: finite exported world box center+heading+lwh, positive sizes, timestamp ordering and frame identity only; not full camera/ego transforms or native restore

disposition_classes.meaning: measured source identity/index/nonfinite/units or deterministic wiring error
disposition_classes.action: block execution, preserve record and repair; not a D/C method failure

disposition_classes.meaning: known source-domain lack/proxy weakness, e.g. no FRONT projection; other cameras remain available
disposition_classes.action: retain in diagnostic/acquisition queue; no formal P decision without frozen requirements

disposition_classes.meaning: missing scene G, actor association, legal body mask or frozen U/H0
disposition_classes.action: prepare inputs or explicit restricted alternative scope; not evidence of physical inability

disposition_classes.meaning: required reconstruction/surface/background/motion evidence unmeasured or threshold uncalibrated
disposition_classes.action: formal gate null; do not display pass/fail

disposition_classes.meaning: only after source features and calibration-locked thresholds determine P=0
disposition_classes.action: retain all original tasks for coverage/refusal/capability boundary; current count unavailable

disposition_classes.meaning: all required measured features satisfy prelocked calibrated thresholds for this q
disposition_classes.action: eligible primary D cohort; not proof of complete car or successful editing; none currently asserted

geometry.inputs: legal original body mask, trusted sparse depth, exact camera/time/gauge, complete static+dynamic G
geometry.function: Within valid original visible-body/depth pixels, count pixels with sufficient front-to-back accumulated all-branch contribution near measured depth; record original none RGB error separately.
geometry.numerator: trusted-depth body pixels with accepted accumulated near-depth support
geometry.unknown: No trusted depth does not mean consistent depth; no body mask gives no formal f_geom. Candidate/dynamic branch alone is forbidden.
geometry.current_status: unmeasured; full-cloud/LiDAR-center plots are diagnostic geometry resources only

view.inputs: actual requested q pose, original camera/actor full poses, measured actor-local points/surface samples, color/depth visibility
view.function: For actual q-required source-estimable visible surface samples, test historical actual depth-visible/color-supported observation directions. Track out-of-sample and unobservable surfaces explicitly.
view.unknown: A complete visible 2D box, many points, 12 sectors or many frames never proves complete hidden surfaces. Surface locations absent from source cannot be silently omitted from completeness denominator.
view.current_proxy: full/raw and recommended49 per-camera projected annotation counts and 30degree bearings; illustrative previous +30degree yaw only; not qualification

background.inputs: original masks, registered q reveal-domain estimate, original historical calibrated rays and valid measured background depth
background.function: Map registered reveal pixels/estimated world samples to historical source views. Count only same-world, depth-consistent directly observed returns outside target/other moving occluders; record color/illumination validity.
denominators: all predeclared reveal-domain pixels/rays or world samples
background.unknown: If reveal domain or world surface cannot be established, f_bg=null with counts. Never use observed-only points as the full reveal denominator. Road-plane interpolation is a geometric hypothesis, not direct observation.
separation: measured but unused by a candidate rule
background.delete_vs_shift: delete reveals original footprint; shift registers vacated and new-location constraints separately; no independent no-car GT

motion.inputs: source timestamps/poses/track ID plus original model time map, world-model gauge, camera and actor transforms and native active interval
motion.function: Validate bijective raw/model time linkage, transform inverse/roundtrip and full actor pose mapping on every registered frame; cross-check observed trajectory continuity descriptively.
motion.unknown: Monotone source timestamps and finite positive boxes are necessary exported-field checks, not full native f_motion. Annotation jitter or track gaps are diagnostic without calibrated tolerance.

threshold_policy.development: Freeze feature functions and source bank on a separate development/calibration ancestry before sealed evaluation; no method/edit-outcome criterion.
threshold_policy.existing_queue: keep original45 and priorities unchanged; deliver facts/reasons rather than45-pass label
threshold_policy.zero_support_policy: known zero within a defined observed domain is recorded as zero; unmeasured depth/visibility or missing source is unknown, not zero

freeze_and_leakage_checks: exact allowlisted source paths and hashes; no recursive result harvesting
feature values identical with reference/edited/student directories inaccessible
identical G/O yields identical actor features for different student methods
q changes predeclared view/background requirements only; source row binding h remains shared
record all actor/q frames before screening; preserve rejected/unknown denominator and reasons
all geometry displays explicitly record branch scope, crop/opacity filters and source/modeled time; no center-NN to f_geom promotion

existing_resources.source_observations: all1228 per-frame source box/time/camera projection and annotation LiDAR counts available locally
existing_resources.reconstructed_scene_inventory: four existing scene checkpoint/window inventories;369 registered tracks lie in these scenes, only8 mapped dynamic assets
existing_resources.mask_inventory: 8 target mask summaries,7 positive medians and1 medianzero;45queue has6 summaries,5 positive medians and1 medianzero; positive mask frame counts unknown
existing_resources.root_complete_G_cache: three scenes have local all-row static+dynamic exports plus temporal fields and same-gauge local_from_world; root owns G/LiDAR comparison
existing_resources.capability_of_cache: supports source-center/ellipsoid diagnostics at exact model time; not an opacity-composited f_geom or owner/complete-surface truth

badcase_mapping.title: 1. 身份或对象归属错误
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 部分证实：真实删除后有车形残留；尚无可靠逐点归属真值。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 部分证实：独立无车参考确认残影真实；仍不能给每颗高斯唯一身份。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 现象明确；把原因唯一归为身份错分仍是待验证解释，错几何、错颜色和缺观测都可能参与。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Only legal original full-scene body/depth/motion conflicts can flag ambiguity; static-branch membership is not a failure or exclusion.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Prepare actor-independent U and source-row map using full static+dynamic G; keep other actors. No unique physical Gaussian owner can be inferred from a box.

badcase_mapping.title: 2. 候选检测漏选
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 部分证实：严格规则几乎不动残影，放宽会伤背景；初始化也有候选留存路径。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 已证实：严格规则只覆盖约1.4%–7.6%的删前贡献；扩到99.9%仍不够。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 已测的是可见贡献覆盖；“哪些点实际属于车”和“最终哪些该编辑”仍需分开判断。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Preedit full-scene alpha*T contribution covered by U may measure visible contribution recall, never semantic recall.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Record sum_U alpha*T / sum_full_static alpha*T in legal original body ROI, denominators and candidate-external support; no edit-result filtering.

badcase_mapping.title: 3. 删除后显露新来源
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 未找到同等级专项验证：有残影，但不能直接拿残影当作这条机制的证据。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 已证实：删后来源贡献猛增，约78.08%来自原输入中极弱可见的点。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 78.08%是来源贡献占比，不是错误成因占比；也不表示这些点都应跟车删除。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Original weak contribution does not prove irrelevant ownership; hidden source membership cannot be established by a front image.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Retain uncertainty and candidate-external ledger. Any later controlled visibility intervention needs a separately frozen analysis domain, not an actor pass label.

badcase_mapping.title: 4. 几何位置或尺度错误
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 部分证实：车辆点过度外扩可测；约束后外扩数能降到0。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 部分证实：独立道路参考与删后深度/空间支撑不一致；正确逐点位置仍未建立。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 框外中心不自动等于错误身份；深度不同也不能唯一决定某颗高斯该移到哪里。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Original measured LiDAR vs all-branch Gaussian centers/ellipsoids may reveal distance or footprint anomalies, without proving ownership.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Use full source G time/gauge, exact 3D actor pose, actual sparse returns and per-frame depth consistency; center NN/OBB plots remain proxies.

badcase_mapping.title: 5. 表面身份正确，外观错误
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 尚未独立证实完整前提；做过固定几何、归属的137点颜色拟合。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 尚未独立证实完整前提；借独立无车答案改128个点的颜色能改善图像。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 颜色参与错误已见到；“身份和几何都正确，剩下只有颜色问题”仍未证明。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Original RGB/SH directional support and residual can be described; pure-road identity and correct geometry are not established by color fitting improvements.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Retain original color evidence and raw radiance range; do not open color optimization or label a causal appearance-only failure.

badcase_mapping.title: 6. 一颗高斯承担多个表面
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 尚未独立证实：跨车/路像素贡献存在，但两侧几何支撑未成立。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 尚未独立证实：做过拆分原型，未证明原点物理上确实混合多表面。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 同一个点投影到两类像素，不等于真的对应两个表面；先确认前提，再评价如何拆。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Body/keep dual projection or contribution is a conflict proxy, not proof of two physical support surfaces.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Require independent depth support on both sides to investigate; preserve conflicts, do not split Gaussians or exclude the actor as proven mixed support.

badcase_mapping.title: 7. 车辆关联效应留在其他表面
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 部分证实：有旧影区代理参考和时间显隐诊断；并非所有暗区都是阴影。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 未专项验证：有仿真阴影差分代理，尚未用它完成本条优化验收。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 遮挡、真实阴影、反射、错几何和环境回填仍可能混在一起，缺精确分离标签。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Dark source pixels, temporal change and shadow on/off Monte Carlo differences do not supply exact shadow labels.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Separate measured illumination/visibility variation from geometry/env uncertainty; no dark-pixel threshold for actor acceptance.

badcase_mapping.title: 8. 背景本来就没重建好或没被看见
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 已证实：有无道路参考、无有效支撑以及补片被原背景挡住的实际案例。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 已证实：原16视图仅50.54%的道路采样点至少可见一次。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 没有观测、观测没被规则用到、没建出几何、建出来却被遮住，是四种不同情况。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Historical measured rays can establish support for particular registered world points; missing history and unbuilt geometry are distinct.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Freeze reveal-domain estimates from legal original masks/poses; test same-world historical depth-visible, non-target returns; retain every unknown reveal ray in denominator.

badcase_mapping.title: 9. 环境层参与形成残影
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 已证实：一个后删状态160个暗像素的高斯贡献为0，暗色全来自环境。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 未专项定位：换白底是诊断，不能自动说明仿真暗区具体来自哪里。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 环境层已经定位清楚；正确道路应是什么仍未知，白底不等于道路恢复。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Original C_G, alpha, E and fill=(1-alpha)E can show layer dependence; no deletion result may enter qualification.
badcase_mapping.next_action: If original native layers are available, retain raw layer contribution and compositor identities; env dominance is not restored-road evidence.

badcase_mapping.title: 10. 数值与合成放大异常
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 已证实：颜色越界、负环境值、阴影精度错误与合成退化均有实测。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 有源码路径核查：颜色无上界、环境直接学习；尚未单独证明它是残影根因。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 算得准、显示截断和修好编辑是三件事；数值修复有效不代表归属或道路已正确。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Nonfinite inputs/compositor identity errors are engineering invalidity. HDR/out-of-[0,1] radiance alone is a measured warning, not automatically a bug.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Check FP32 C+fill and fill identities, source color conventions, alpha/depth units; preserve raw values before display clamping.

badcase_mapping.title: 11. 编辑后的覆盖、遮挡或视向外观改变
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 已证实：同一车辆资产参数完全不变，覆盖下降、静态遮挡增加。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 未做同等级专项量化：仿真跑过转向，变淡原因的详细数字来自Waymo。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 已量到覆盖和遮挡变化；未观测侧面、视向外观是否还贡献错误，需要分开检验。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Box bearings are coarse direction proxies. Required surfaces, visibility, footprints and color directions must be measured for the actual requested q.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Use camera/actor source poses and measured actor-local surface samples; compare q-required visible samples to legal observation bank with occlusion and depth checks.

badcase_mapping.title: 12. 时间状态或跨帧绑定不稳定
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 部分证实：3个真实路段逐帧候选变化、时间显隐已测；身份跳变未独立证实。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 未专项验证：只检查少量时刻，未做16帧完整时序归属验收。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 可见性、投影范围和掩码都会改变候选；需要真正共享身份和顺序/跳帧对照。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Timestamp monotonicity, positive boxes and track gaps are measurable now; they do not validate native time/gauge/shared binding.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Validate raw-to-model time, full pose transforms and actor identity on all registered frames. Same source row binding h remains shared across q and time.

badcase_mapping.title: 13. 工程或可视化接线错误
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_real: 已证实：出现过左右视图不同步、入口默认隐藏车辆等接线问题。
badcase_mapping.attachment_evidence_sim: 已证实：出现过像素查询和相机恢复问题，已修并复核。
badcase_mapping.attachment_causal_limit: 工程门禁必须先过，但这些修复不能记成新归属/背景算法的科学收益。
badcase_mapping.source_only_check: Context/track/raw frame/camera consistency and source checksum mismatches are engineering issues, not scientific method failures.
badcase_mapping.next_action: Verify frame-synchronized RGB+3D-box+LiDAR views and explicit source metadata; missing media gets a visible unavailable state.
